reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports on gene expression (transcriptomics) and microarray data, not genotype frequencies of insecticide resistance markers (SNPs, CNVs, or SVs).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers; it focuses on gene expression levels.

african_field_population.evidence: The laboratory strains (KWAG-perm, MBN-DDT) were derived from field-collected mosquitoes in Mamfene, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study using microarray and qPCR analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the origin of the strains as Mamfene, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains with known collection/colonization histories.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states it is a follow-up study using the same strains as Nardini et al. (2012) and Munhenga and Koekemoer (2011).

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study uses microarray and qPCR to analyze gene expression profiles in laboratory-selected pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles arabiensis strains from South Africa. It does not report genotype frequencies for insecticide resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report genotype data for any of the specified insecticide resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: The paper does not report genotype counts or frequencies.
